answer: Sybil resistance can be a live, time-boxed probe rather than a signup form. Before any reward vests, the ledger draws a seed-derived question from a public crystal of recent network facts and gives the claimant a few minutes to post a signed reply. Established peers independently re-run that same prompt and compare the traces. A real operator returns a timely, unique echo; a factory hidden in an ocean of cloned keys either misses the window or repeats a sibling's wording, which slashes the posted bond and voids the identity.
